timing: Pi read-completion timestamps; USB/camera buffering delay is uncalibrated. No ADC or exposure timestamps.
video_timing: AVI constant FPS with repeated frames aligned to Pi timestamps. Use video_frames.csv for AVI-frame mapping and frames.csv for source-frame times.
arduino: ECG:<0..1023> TAB PPG:<0..1023>; no sample counter, so serial loss cannot be proven absent.
heart_rate: Display-only PPG peak-interval estimate; raw CSV unchanged. Estimator range 35-200 BPM; not diagnostic.
ecg_display: 0.5-40 Hz zero-phase band-pass with 60 Hz notch; saved ECG remains raw ADC.
recording: Preview begins after connection. Each button-started take is saved in a separate TAKE_### folder after a three-second countdown.
